Q65 is complete and starts fresh - B2 confirmed it ended cleanly at Q64, and p12 opens with Q65 (left column) and Q67 (right column) exactly as B2 reported. Q93 is complete and ends the right column of p17; nothing spills into B4. TWO COLUMN-BREAKS, both the same shape: on p13 Q70's four statements end the left column while its 'Which of the statements given above are correct?' line and all four code rows are printed at the TOP of the right column above Q71, and on p16 Q83's four statements do the same above Q84.
